topic: How do interference mitigation techniques adapt when handling tunneled versus non-tunneled traffic in multi-beam satellite systems?
response: Interference mitigation techniques in multi-beam satellite systems adapt by optimizing transmit beamforming and receive beamforming to minimize interference, with considerations for spatial diversity and band reuse. Techniques include analog beamforming and power allocation.
reference_context: SatCom systems use beamforming, power allocation, and interference mitigation to optimize performance, with applications in multibeam satellite systems and spectrum sharing.
